'''Allcargo Gati Limited''' is an Indian [[logistics]] company headquartered in [[Hyderabad]], [[Telangana]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/gati-plans-more-investment-in-warehouses-109020800081_1.html|title=Gati plans more investment in warehouses|agency=Press Trust of India|date=2009-02-08|work=Business Standard India|access-date=2017-10-10}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.livemint.com/Companies/v0bQWGdTukUXKZIBHCtkfI/Gati-to-set-up-joint-venture-with-Japan8217s-Kintetsu-Wor.html|title=Gati to set up joint venture with Japan's Kintetsu World Express - Livemint|website=www.livemint.com|date=13 February 2012|access-date=2017-10-10}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite news|url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/gati-to-make-ecommerce-foray/article7962204.ece|title=Gati to make e-commerce foray|last=Kurmanath|first=K V|date=2015-12-08|work=The Hindu Business Line|access-date=2017-10-10|language=en}}</ref> It engages in surface and air express logistics, [[warehousing]], supply chain, air freight, and [[E-commerce in India|e-commerce]] services. Founded in 1989, Gati first started operations between Madras (now [[Chennai]]) and [[Madurai]].

In 2020, it was acquired by [[Allcargo Logistics]]. [[Shashi Kiran Shetty]], chairman and founder of Allcargo Logistics Ltd., currently serves as the chairman.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/shetty-takes-over-as-gati-chairman/article32192745.ece|title=Mr. Shetty takes over as Gati Ltd. Chairman}}</ref> Gati is listed on the [[National Stock Exchange India|National Stock Exchange]] and [[Bombay Stock Exchange]].

== History ==

=== Early history ===
Gati was founded in 1989 and began providing same-day courier and distribution services and courier management between [[Chennai]] and Madurai. The company expanded to [[Hyderabad]], Bangalore (now [[Bengaluru]]), Chennai and [[Hosur]] within the same year.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.customercarenumber.co.in/utility-services/gati-courier-limited-corporate-office-details.html|title=Gati Courier Ltd|date=13 February 2015|language=en-US|access-date=2017-10-10}}</ref> It became the first company in India to start providing the delivery date on the docket and started offering a money back guarantee.<ref>{{Cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=_G4gBQAAQBAJ&q=gati+money+back+guarantee&pg=PA63|title=Bringing Strategy Back: How Strategic Shock Absorbers Make Planning Relevant in a World of Constant Change|last=Sampler|first=Jeffrey L.|date=2014-10-28|publisher=John Wiley & Sons|isbn=9781118830079|language=en}}</ref> The company was incorporated in 1995 as Gati Corporation Ltd.

=== 1996–2000 ===
Began offering multi-modal services, courier services and international operations to [[SAARC]] countries<ref>{{Cite news |date=December 13, 2023 |title=Govt plans to take PM Gati Shakti global, starting with India’s neighbours |url=https://www.livemint.com/news/india/govt-plans-to-take-pm-gati-shakti-global-starting-with-indias-neighbours-11702446865315.html |work=Mint}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2011-03-01 |title=Gati starts road cargo service to Bangladesh |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/economy/logistics/Gati-starts-road-cargo-service-to-Bangladesh/article20105280.ece |access-date=2024-09-21 |website=BusinessLine |language=en}}</ref>

=== 2001–2008: Growth and expansion ===
Launched Vehicle Tracking System, a centralised computer system to manage people, packages and vehicles in real time

Created a centralized call centre in [[Nagpur]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.cio.in/cio-interview/indian-logistics-industry-set-take-giant-leaps-2017|title=Indian logistics industry set to take giant leaps|last=CIO.in|website=CIO India|language=en|access-date=2017-10-21}}</ref>

=== 2009–2012 ===
Gati signed a joint venture agreement with [[Kintetsu World Express]] for their express distribution and supply chain business to form Gati–KWE, which is a subsidiary of Gati.<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.thehindu.com/business/companies/gati-to-form-jv-with-kwe-of-japan/article2889766.ece|title=Gati to form JV with KWE of Japan|date=2012-02-13|work=The Hindu|access-date=2017-10-21|language=en-IN|issn=0971-751X}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.livemint.com/Companies/v0bQWGdTukUXKZIBHCtkfI/Gati-to-set-up-joint-venture-with-Japan8217s-Kintetsu-Wor.html|title=GATI TO SET UP JOINT VENTURE WITH JAPAN'S KINTETSU WORLD EXPRESS|website=livemint.com|date=13 February 2012|language=en|access-date=2017-10-10}}</ref>

Introduced its e-commerce logistics services <ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.indiainfoline.com/article/equity-earnings-result-commentary/gati-q1fy18-consolidated-net-profit-rises-258-8-yoy-117082200732_1.html|title=Gati Q1FY18 consolidated net profit rises 258.8% yoy|last=indiainfoline.com|access-date=2017-10-21}}</ref>

=== 2020-2023===
Acquired by [[Allcargo Logistics]]<ref>{{Cite web |date=June 9, 2023 |title=Allcargo Logistics completes acquisition of 30% stake in Gati subsidiary |url=https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/allcargo-logistics-completes-acquisition-of-30-stake-in-gati-subsidiary-123060900328_1.html}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|title=Gati to return to profitability next quarter: Allcargo Logistics|work=The Economic Times|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/earnings/gati-to-return-to-profitability-next-quarter-allcargo-logistics/articleshow/76217204.cms|access-date=2021-05-08}}</ref>

In October 2023, the company name was changed to Allcargo Gati.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Allcargo-Gati-Limited-Name-Change. |url=https://www.gati.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/Allcargo-Gati-Limited-Name-Change.pdf |access-date=2024-09-16}}</ref>

In June 2025, Allcargo Gati launched a 24-hour air delivery service to eight metro cities in India, aiming to strengthen its express logistics network.<ref>{{cite news |title=Allcargo Gati launches 24‑hour air delivery service to 8 cities |url=https://m.economictimes.com/industry/transportation/shipping-/-transport/allcargo-gati-launches-24-hour-air-delivery-service-to-8-cities/articleshow/121748741.cms |publisher=The Economic Times |date=10 June 2025}}</ref>

The company also became a part of the government-backed Open Network for Digital Commerce (ONDC) to enhance digital last-mile connectivity.<ref>{{cite news |title=Allcargo Gati goes live on ONDC network |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/small-biz/sme-sector/allcargo-gati-goes-live-on-ondc-network/articleshow/121930138.cms |publisher=The Economic Times |date=18 June 2025}}</ref>
